title: Factorial of N numbers
intuition: Recurrence: N! = N·(N−1)!, 0!=1. Values grow fast — mention overflow / big integers. Recursion depth N → RE for large N; iteration is safer.

approaches.title: Recursive
Optimal practical: iterative
approaches.idea: Multiply in a loop — O(1) auxiliary.

edgeCases: large n (big integers / overflow in C++)
followUps: n! mod p (p prime) — Wilson / factorial prefix?
interviewInsight: Trailing zeros of n! is the classic follow-up — tests division by 5s, not multiplication loops.
